DeployBot: Deploy started -> environment=integration.canary, commit=abcdef1234, tag=v1.4.2. CI: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/12345 :rocket:
Alice B: getting alerts from canary, smoke tests failing on first run :eyes:
DeployBot: Pipeline update:
- build: ✅
- lint: ✅
- unit-tests: ✅
- integration-smoke: ❌ (2 failures)
- e2e: skipped
Full logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/12345/logs
QA Bot: Failing tests from integration-smoke:
```
TestContainerStartup::should_register_services
APISmoke::basic_ping_timeout
```
Both timed out ~30s into the run, looks like service registration / discovery hiccup.
Bob R: anyone seen increased pod startup times in the last hour? could be a runtime dependency change.
Carol M: on it, attaching to canary pods now and tailing logs.
SRE Oncall: saw a CPU spike and transient socket errors on node canary-3 at 12:07 UTC, digging into metrics.
DeployBot: Suggested actions: rollback to tag=v1.4.1 or pin to previous commit. To rollback automatically: `/deploy rollback integration canary --to-tag v1.4.1`
Release Manager: Recommend rollback. We should not continue the canary rollout with failing smoke tests. Need a rollback ticket and release-note entry.
Alice B: agree — please rollback and create a follow-up to investigate root cause. Hold the release window until we're confident. :+1:
Carol M: triggering rollback now.
DeployBot: Rollback initiated by Carol M. Command: `/deploy rollback integration canary --to-tag v1.4.1 --reason "smoke fails"`
DeployBot: Rollback in progress... pulling tag v1.4.1 -> deploying 3 pods, waiting for readiness.
DeployBot: Rollback complete. integration.canary now at v1.4.1 (commit=7890fedc). Reran smoke suite: all tests passing. Verification logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/12346/logs :white_check_mark:
Release Manager: Created RED-4123 to track registration flakiness and postmortem. Assigned to Carol M. Adding note to release notes: rollback performed for canary 1975003210 due to smoke failures.
Alice B: thanks — will re-run the candidate after fix; prefer canary-only smoke job before any rollout.
Bob R: also adding an automated health-check step to the pipeline to catch registration failures earlier.
SRE Oncall: marking canary node baseline and adding alert for registration latency spikes. :lock:
Carol M: I'll follow up with logs/condensed timeline in RED-4123.
